en: Black-and-white photograph of a quaint ivy-covered railway station building labeled "RÖSTÅNGA" on a sign above the entrance. The station sits beside multiple train tracks running into the distance. Several people stand on the platform near the building. Trees line the left and background, and the sky is mostly clear. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner of the image.
